indirectRelatedColumnEvidence.feature: Add a two-hop Patient column to CDA Specimen rows

indirectRelatedColumnEvidence.resultCorrectness: The selected Specimen b7cad184-db67-5542-a975-10fffa3e89e7 returned Patient afcfb15e-7617-5691-ae2c-ab675322fb33 through specimen_Specimen then subject_Patient. Independent Arango edge traversal confirmed the route and value. Coverage showed one displayed row with one match.
indirectRelatedColumnEvidence.persistence: Applied, reloaded and previewed, reopened the exact saved route, changed the output label, applied, reloaded and previewed unchanged values, removed the step, and reloaded the restored Specimen table. Disposable table deleted.
indirectRelatedColumnEvidence.remaining: This case has one match. Zero and many related matches require their separate CDA cases; reducing route-selection clicks remains a usability opportunity.

relatedMultiplicityEvidence.feature: Choose zero/many related values and restrict contributing records
relatedMultiplicityEvidence.domUsability: Fields and related data offered Count matching records, all matching values, and presence. Advanced matching choices accepted one Observation ID. Saved route, result form, and equality value reopened correctly. The combined lifecycle used 67 recorded interactions across four operations, filter editing, reloads, removal, and cleanup.
relatedMultiplicityEvidence.resultCorrectness: A fresh Arango oracle restricted edges to Observation resources and confirmed 38 Subject matches for the many Patient and zero for the other. All 38 rendered IDs matched that oracle. The zero Patient remained a row with count 0, an empty all-values cell, and presence false. Contributor filtering reduced the many count to 1; editing the selected ID retained 1.
relatedMultiplicityEvidence.persistence: Each operation was applied and reloaded. The saved contributor rule was edited and reloaded, then an earlier Patient filter was edited to the zero-match Patient. Each of the four related steps was removed individually, with reload and preview after each removal. Restoration showed only Patient ID, and the temporary table was deleted.
relatedMultiplicityEvidence.remaining: This proves the bounded direct Subject route. Multi-hop zero/many cases, row expansion, full-table performance, and the final combined CDA rerun remain separate.
